description: Source code implementing PKCS#12 file handling, including encryption, certificate and key management, and PKCS#12 structure generation using mbedtls library.

classes.name: pkcs12_ctx
classes.description: Context structure for PKCS#12 processing, including buffers, cryptographic parameters, and state flags.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_tag
methods.description: Writes ASN.1 tag and length to the buffer.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_bag
methods.description: Adds a bag structure with specified OID.

methods.name: uc_p12_enc_setup
methods.description: Sets up encryption cipher with derived key.

methods.name: uc_p12_enc_legacy
methods.description: Legacy encryption setup using older derivation method.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_cert
methods.description: Adds a certificate to the PKCS#12 structure, decoding from PEM format.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_key
methods.description: Adds a private key to the PKCS#12 structure, handling EC keys specially.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_authsafe
methods.description: Adds the authSafe structure containing keys and certificates.

methods.name: uc_p12_add_mac_digest_info
methods.description: Adds MAC digest info ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: uc_generate_pkcs12
methods.description: Main function to generate a PKCS#12 structure from input object, including password, certificates, and keys.
